composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap through fog banks to catch drifting radio fragments — each tap clears a pocket of visibility before the mist swallows it again.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: every three fragments assemble into a decoded phrase with a satisfying static pop
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog closes faster and fragments drift farther between taps
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: monochrome mist with amber phosphor glow

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick morse dots across a warped radio dial to spell intercepted telegraph words before the signal dies in the static.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: completing one word triggers a crackle-and-decode animation in under a minute
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: interference bands sweep the dial, shrinking the valid hit zones
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: sepia telegraph paper with green phosphor dots

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Drag geometric shapes onto a poster grid and snap them to match an evolving AI brief before the judge scores your layout.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: instant aesthetic score flashes after each placement — chase a perfect 30-second composition
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: brief constraints multiply: color limits, symmetry rules, forbidden overlaps
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: risograph textures with bold flat ink blocks

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Swipe between firewall layers one-handed to find the one weak port before an autonomous security bot patches it shut.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: breaching a layer triggers a cascade unlock animation — one clean run in 45 seconds
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: bot scan speed ramps and decoy ports multiply across lanes
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: neon wireframe terminal on deep black
